data.name: Aaliah
data.gender_notes: Aaliah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aaliah is derived from the Arabic word 'Aala' which means 'high' or 'exalted'. The name Aaliah carries the meaning “High, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aaliah usually hope their child will grow to embody high, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Aaliah is often associated with lofty ideals and noble character traits.
data.etymology: Aaliah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “High, Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaliah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، يعني الرفعة و العلو في الدنيا و الآخرة، و يدل على مكانة عالية و رفيعة في المجتمع الإسلامي، و هو مشتق من الفعل 'عَلا' الذي يعني الارتفاع و العلو

in_urdu.name: عالیہ
in_urdu.meaning: دنیا و آخرت میں رفعت و بلندی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عالیہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے، جس کا مطلب دنیا و آخرت میں رفعت و بلندی ہے، اور یہ اسلامی معاشرے میں ایک اعلیٰ و رفیع مقام کی نشان دہی کرتا ہے، اور یہ فعل 'عَلا' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ارتفاع و علو

in_hindi.name: आलिया
in_hindi.meaning: दुनिया और آخرत में ऊंचाई और सम्मान
